title: Ephraim's Sins

questions.question: Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; they multiply falsehood and what?
The Lord has an indictment against Judah and will punish Jacob according to his what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:2 (ESV): "and will punish Jacob according to his ways;"

questions.question: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he strove with whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:3 (ESV): "and in his manhood he strove with God."

questions.question: By a prophet the Lord brought Israel up from where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:13 (ESV): "By a prophet the Lord brought Israel up from Egypt,"

questions.question: Ephraim has given bitter provocation; so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt on him and pay him back for his what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:14 (ESV): "and pay him back for his disgrace."

questions.question: He strove with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought his favor. He met God at where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:4 (ESV): "He met God at Bethel, and there he spoke with us"

questions.question: So you, by the help of your God, return, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:6 (ESV): "and wait continually for your God."

questions.question: A merchant, in whose hands are false balances, he loves to do what?
Ephraim has said, "Ah, but I am rich; I have found wealth for myself." In all my labors they cannot find in me iniquity or what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:8 (ESV): "they cannot find in me iniquity or sin."

questions.question: I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; I will again make you dwell in what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:9 (ESV): "I will again make you dwell in tents,"

questions.question: They make a covenant with Assyria, and what is carried to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:1 (ESV): "and oil is carried to Egypt."

questions.question: I spoke to the prophets; it was I who multiplied visions, and through the prophets gave what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:10 (ESV): "and through the prophets gave parables."

questions.question: If there is iniquity in Gilead, they shall surely come to nothing: in Gilgal they sacrifice what?
Their altars shall be like what in the furrows of the field?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:11 (ESV): "their altars also are like stone heaps in the furrows of the field."

questions.question: Jacob fled to the land of Aram; there Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he did what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 12:12 (ESV): "and for a wife he guarded sheep."

key_verse_text: So you, by the help of your God, return, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for your God.
